description: The file defines a PHP interface 'ResourceEndpoint' that specifies the contract for API resource endpoints, including methods for CRUD operations and their validation rules. It is part of the OrangeHRM project and resides under the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2'.

classes.name: ResourceEndpoint
classes.description: An interface that defines the contract for API resource endpoints, including methods for retrieving, updating, deleting resources, and obtaining validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single resource. Throws exceptions if retrieval fails or if access is forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a resource. Throws exceptions if update fails or if access is forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource. Throws exceptions if deletion fails or if access is forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'delete' operation.
